title: Deterministic fixed-P BSGS with conservative bit arithmetic; explicit routed storage

claims.statement: For every valid full-production BLS12-381 fixed-G1 pairing inversion input (P,z), the deterministic cold BSGS algorithm in proof.md and routing.md returns the actual Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z, with success probability 1, total classical computation at most 2^154 dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at C=20000, including all preprocessing, lookup, transfers, verification and output. Peak memory is at most 2^147 bytes; preprocessing is at most 2^154 equivalents and included in total; nonuniform advice is at most 1 byte and included in peak storage. This analytic bound uses no heuristic, powers input, target amortization or quantum computation and does not claim practical execution.
